subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/config contract should be accepted?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential storage, Google consent/scopes, data visibility for non-mentioned Space messages, and fallback behavior; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat to mentioned webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered only, while finishing thread-reply reliability through narrower issues or PRs.

options.title: Defer to broader Workspace auth
options.body: Hold this feature until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local OAuth/events design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal from thread-reply landing history and prior maintainer-side review of the overlapping Google Chat OAuth/security boundary.
